reviewMethod: All 10 original exported PNGs opened with view_image, inspected individually, and SHA-256 checked against index.json. No image edited, cropped, composited, or regenerated.
result: PASS for the confirmed-card calendar hierarchy and original whole-card navigation destination in the four supplied appearance/text combinations, with explicit limits below.
limitations: The fixtures intentionally display network connection failed/retry above the confirmed card; screenshots establish fixture layout rather than live backend success.
Maximum-font confirmed cards are inspected using two continuous vertical segments each; the card is not asserted to fit the screen in one frame.
Original route screenshots prove the existing destination only; they do not constitute full private-chat maximum-font or whole-app localization acceptance.
Device AssistiveTouch appears in the screenshots and remains an OS-controlled overlay.

This screenshot set contains the same-day 27 October 18:00–19:30 fixture. Cross-day/year/zone preservation is supported by unchanged rendering branches and separate source/date-format verification, not new cross-day/year/zone pixels in these 10 captures.
